chapters.title: Contend for the faith and guard against corruption

parts.text: Jude urges the called and preserved believers to contend for the faith once delivered to the saints. Intruders distort grace into lust and deny the Lord. Examples from unbelieving Israel, fallen angels, and Sodom demonstrate judgment. Their reckless slander contrasts with Michael’s restraint, and their greed and rebellion resemble Cain, Balaam, and Core. Jude describes their fruitlessness and cites Enoch’s announcement of the Lord’s coming judgment upon the ungodly.

The readers should remember the apostles’ warning about last-time mockers and recognize divisive people lacking the Spirit. They must build themselves up in faith, pray in the Holy Ghost, remain in God’s love, and look for Christ’s mercy. With discernment they should show compassion and rescue others. Jude praises God’s power to keep them and present them faultless.
